defect: A member with a mismatched key kind is skipped only when the type uses string keys (if (!isIntKey)); for integer-key types it is not skipped and falls through into the string-key branch.
why: The skip must apply to both key kinds; for integer-key types the mismatched member is added to stringMembers, mixing the tables the analyzer builds and risking the throw that N1 forbids.
